answer: Kiln-ember saffron proof — one $14 thermocouple in a real saffron-drying kiln is the price of an identity. At dawn the kiln is lit, and the sensor logs the ember temperature every minute; the drying auditor matches the curve against the kiln's published saffron-drying profile, and a forged curve misses the 40°C plateau and fails on the spot. A second identity claiming the same kiln repeats the same curve, and the pair is struck together. Saffron dries once a year, so a farm cannot rush a second harvest to mint a second identity.
